doc.name: DarkFunnels
doc.description: Vende por WhatsApp con un agente de ventas IA — y opéralo desde tu asistente.

skills.name: darkfunnels
skills.description: Use when a business wants an AI sales agent on the WhatsApp number it already uses (connected by QR, no Meta Cloud API, no templates), or when an assistant such as Claude, ChatGPT or Codex needs to operate a DarkFunnels workspace over MCP — audit conversations, edit the sales playbook, manage the catalog, read orders and metrics.
